ronmc.gun.b1301_g.name: §6Golden or Not B1301
ronmc.gun.b1301_g.desc: §6Have fun with the Supporter Edition. (This Weapon is a Gold Black Edition of the B1301 available exclusively to Patreon supporters.)
ronmc.gun.57usg.desc: This modern, high capacity pistol boasts a proprietary cartridge with excellent penetration.
ronmc.gun.590m.desc: This shotgun is a magazine-fed pump action with a 10 round detachable box magazine.
ronmc.gun.b1301.desc: A sturdy tactical shotgun hailing from italy. Its unique bolt design reduces muzzle climb compared to its counterparts.
ronmc.gun.beanbag_shot.desc: This less lethal shotgun fires powerful 12GA beanbag rounds that immobilize suspects on impact.
ronmc.gun.entryman.desc: (Part of the Supporter Edition) A sturdy tactical shotgun hailing from italy. Its unique bolt design reduces muzzle climb compared to its counterparts.
ronmc.gun.hk416.desc: Integrally suppressed .300 Blackout carbine based on the MCX platform, prioritizing portability and concealability in non-standart situations.
ronmc.gun.m32a1.desc: A rotary launcher originally made for military use with high-explosive ammunition, it has found its use with Los Suenos' riot control units SWAT teams.
ronmc.gun.m1014.desc: This gas powered combat shotgun is widely considered the best of its breed. Reliable and fast firing, its only major drawback is how quickly you'll empty it.
ronmc.gun.mk16.desc: Developed to become the workhorse of special forces units, it's now a popular choice for both the civilian market and law enforcement use.
ronmc.gun.mk17.desc: The MK17 is a highly modular battle rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm, favored for its adaptability across diverse combat environments.
ronmc.gun.mk18.desc: A homegrown American icon commonly found in SWAT teams nationwide, the MK18 eschews raw firepower in favor of top handling, low recoil, and familiarity.
ronmc.gun.mkv.desc: The MkV is a hand cannon chambered in the massive .50 AE cartridge, delivering unmatched stopping power at the cost of high recoil.
ronmc.gun.mp5_10mm.desc: A variation of the MP5 that was made to meet the FBI's needs in the late 80s, the 10mm cartridge packs a heavy punch, and found use with HRT and SWAT units.
ronmc.gun.mp5a2.desc: This iconic submachine gun set the standard for law enforcement for half a century. Although modern platforms have since overtaken it.
ronmc.gun.mp5a3.desc: A modernized version of the MP5, with an improvement kit that extends its usability within the requirements of weapon systems in this current decade.
ronmc.gun.mp5sd6.desc: The MP5SD6 is an integrally suppressed submachine gun based on the iconic MP5 weapons platform.
ronmc.gun.trpl.desc: The TRPL is a compact, pistol-sized pepperball launcher, firing high-impact CS gas rounds to disable threats without lethal force. Moddeled after traditional duty pistols.
ronmc.gun.ump9.desc: A 9mm version in the UMP platform. Compared to it's .45 counterpart, this variant has a higher magazine capacity and a slightly higher fire rate.
ronmc.gun.ump45.desc: Intended as a successor to the dated MP5, this slow firing submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP boasts stopping power and excellent ergonomics.
ronmc.gun.usp45.desc: This German made Pistol is chambered in .45 ACP and boasts a higher capacity than other handguns of its caliber.
ronmc.gun.mp7.desc: A personal defense weapon originally designed for fielding with rear-echelon troops during the Cold War.
ronmc.gun.mp9.desc: An Austrian design, upgraded for modern use. Compact, lightweight and a high rate of fire makes it suitable for close range engagements.
ronmc.gun.m1911.desc: Custom 1911 for the Los Suenos Police Department, A classic semi-automatic handgun cherished by those who appreciate timeless craftsmanship and accuracy,
ronmc.gun.mcx.desc: Highly popular with modern police tactical units all over the world, the MCX platform is slowly taking over the AR15 in terms of modularity, performance and customization.
ronmc.gun.glock_19.desc: Chambered in 9x19mm, the G19's dependability and high capacity have found it a permanent home in public and privat security agencies worldwide.
ronmc.gun.p90.desc: A personal defense weapon with an unconventional appearance originally designed for fielding with rear echelon troops during the Cold War.
ronmc.gun.supernova.desc: A Pump-Action Shotgun from Italy. The Supernova makes extensive use of polymer, making it very lightweight and easy to handle.
ronmc.gun.870cqb.desc: Iconic Pump-Action found in police cruisers across the World.Thos workhorse features a rail for optics and an integrated flashlight.
ronmc.gun.fp9c_g19.desc: (Part of the Supporter Edition) Chambered in 9x19mm, the G19's dependability and high capacity have found a home in public and privat security agencies.
ronmc.gun.357_magnum.desc: This powerful revolver is limited to only six shots but boasts substantial power behind each one. High on recoil and awkward to reload, it's a relic of policing.
ronmc.gun.glock_18c.desc: The G18-C is a select-fire variant of the iconic G17, capable of firing in full auto at a blistering 1200 rounds per minute.
ronmc.gun.rtwc.desc: The RTWC is a designed marksman rifle built for longrange accuracy and repeatable, match-grade performance.
ronmc.gun.sti_2011.desc: The S2011 is a modernized rendition of the 1911 platform chambered in 9x19mm featuring a crisp, short-reset trigger. §bBy "duskdawn"
ronmc.gun.f90.desc: A bullpup rifle made in Australia, it's modular design and compact form makes it shine in adaptability and maneuverability rhus making it ideal for close quarters combat.
ronmc.gun.509.desc: The 509 Pistol stands out with its exceptional ergonomics and reliability, designed for both self-defense and tactical operations.
ronmc.gun.b92x.desc: The standard issue service pistol of the US military for nearly thirty years, this modernized design has found a second life in the hand of police units across the country.
ronmc.gun.g36c.desc: Chambered in 5.56 and boasting a rigid, polymer design, folding stock and short barrel, ensuring maximum maneuverbility in close-quarters battle.
ronmc.gun.g3a3.desc: The G3A3 is a robust, full-sized battle rifle chambered in 7.52x51mm, known for its reliablity and long-range effectiveness.
ronmc.gun.ga416.desc: Modern German assault rifle that has rapidly found favor from operators worldwide, including the US Navy's SEAL Team Six. Known for reliabilty and operational durability.
ronmc.gun.m11.desc: Popular among law enforcement units, the M11 Compact is an accurate, reliable and robust 9mm pistol. §bBy "duskdawn"
ronmc.gun.m14.desc: The M14 is a classic American battle rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm, combining range, firepower and precision.
ronmc.gun.m45a1.desc: An improved version of the 1911 developed to meet the requirements of special operations forces in US military. §bBy "duskdawn"
ronmc.gun.mpx.desc: This modern pistol caliber carbine combines the best aspect of a submachine gun with the controls of the AR platform, maximizing familiarity amd comfort.
ronmc.gun.raider.desc: The Raider X MP17 (P320) from FLUX Defense combines the agility of a pistol with the stability of a carbine, offering unparalleled versatility.
ronmc.gun.train_g19.desc: A Glock 19 for use in training areas. Not ideal for combat!
ronmc.gun.train_mk18.desc: A MK18 for use in training areas. Not ideal for combat!
ronmc.gun.shorty.desc: Quickly and effectively blows open doors using frangible slugs. Not ideal for combat!
ronmc.gun.arn.desc: A short and compact assault rifle chambered in .300 Blackout, suitable for CQB operations.
ronmc.gun.arwc.desc: CQB-oriented rifle. Stout, reliable and robust.
ronmc.gun.dm4.desc: The DM4 PDW is a compact powerhouse chambered in .300 Blackout, perfect for close-quarter combat. Its superior handling and short configuration make it an ideal choice.
ronmc.gun.ga51.desc: The GA51 is a compact, hard-hitting battle rifle, offering the firepower of a 7.62x51mm round in a much smaller frame. Its shortened barrel increases recoil and muzzle flash.
ronmc.gun.sa58.desc: A sturdy and proven battle rifle chambered in 7.62x51mm nad midified for close quarter operations. Powerful penetration requires shot placement to avoid collateral damage.
ronmc.gun.slr.desc: While an uncoventional choice for most police departments, AK-based platforms have found niche use due to its accessible and reliable controls.
ronmc.gun.sr16.desc: This lightweight carbine features a full length quad rail system and impressive muzzle velocity, encouraging customization and boasting precision and accuracy.
ronmc.gun.spc.desc: Special Purpos Carbine chambered in 9mm. Designed with the controls of the AR Platform, light and compact submachine gun with a very high fire rate.
ronmc.gun.vpl.desc: This modern, 25 round magazine fed pepperball Launcher features full length rails and familiar AR-style controls.
ronmc.gun.tpl.desc: A compact mag-fed pepperball Launcher, its overall smaller design makes it ideal for close range engaments. It features a limited magazine capacity but its easier to reload.
